"U.S." is a proper noun premodifying a common-noun head, which Names and casing says never fuses: the licensed route is the head noun typed on its own plus (Possession <group> us) and a (Name us "U.S.") fact, whereas the parse fuses us_researcher and emits no Name atom for the U.S. anywhere.

a proportional quantifier inside a seal - a sealed rule carries no STV of its own, so "nearly one in 10" (~0.1 strength) survives only as the QuantifierPhrase word and the proportion itself has no carrier
